title: GlowPath
seoIntro: GlowPath is a swipe puzzle about lighting every active square from one starting point without wasting the route.
seoDetails: GlowPath turns each board into a clean pathfinding challenge. Start on the pulsing entry tile, swipe through adjacent squares, backtrack when needed, and finish when every active tile glows.
seoHowToPlay: Press the starting tile, then swipe through unlit neighboring tiles. Holes are blocked, revisiting a lit tile is ignored unless it is the previous square, and a completed route lights the whole stage.
seoFeatures: Start from the pulsing entry square
Swipe through each active tile exactly once
Backtrack one step to repair a route without restarting
designNotes: The useful move in GlowPath is often the one that preserves exits. Watch corners and narrow bridges before committing, because a bright-looking route can still strand an unlit square.
controls: Tap the pulsing start tile to begin
Swipe or drag into adjacent active tiles
Swipe into the previous tile to undo the last step
playerTips: Trace the forced corners before lighting the middle
Use backtracking immediately when a route traps itself
Leave branching areas flexible until the path shape is clear

guideSections.heading: Who GlowPath Is For
guideSections.copy: GlowPath fits players who like compact logic puzzles with a tactile swipe rhythm. Each stage is short, readable, and built around finding one continuous route through the lit squares.

guideSections.heading: Reading the Board
guideSections.copy: Look for dead ends, corners, and narrow connectors before you start moving quickly. Strong routes usually handle constrained tiles first, then use open space to connect the remaining squares.

guideSections.heading: Using Backtrack
guideSections.copy: Backtracking is not a penalty. If the route blocks itself, swipe into the previous square, turn off the last tile, and correct the path while the board shape is still fresh.

faq.question: What kind of puzzle is GlowPath?
faq.answer: GlowPath is a path puzzle where you light every active square by swiping a continuous route from the starting tile.

faq.question: Can I undo a move in GlowPath?
faq.answer: Yes. Swipe back into the previous square to turn off the last tile and continue from there.

Keep steering inputs deliberate through corners before accelerating out
